title: Celestial Cinema Balcony
description: A robed figure with flowing hair stands on an ornate stone balcony overgrown with vines and white flowers, holding a blue book while gazing at a massive floating planet with rings and a domed city inside. The surreal night scene features film reels, spotlights, satellite dishes, and film-strip frames floating in the air alongside a large cinema-like portal revealing a Saturn-like planet and a futuristic waterside city.
prompt: A lone robed figure with long flowing hair stands on an ornate stone balcony covered in vines and white flowers, holding an open blue book. In the night sky floats a large ringed planet containing a glowing domed city, alongside floating film reels, spotlights, old satellite dishes and film strip frames. A large vertical film-strip portal on the right reveals a Saturn-like planet over a futuristic city by the water, all rendered in intricate detailed surreal fantasy style.
